Players Committee card image of [[Major Taslin Brance]] (original printing), game text: “If opponent just looked at cards in their deck or pile, after replacing, you may peek at the top card of that deck or pile. At the start of your control phase, if the top card of your lost pile is a Resistance character or [Restistance] starship, opponent loses 1 Force.”
